x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: Migrate skills from tables which extend task which have a property name like com.snc.skills_management.{table_name}_migrate_skills with value set to true, to task_m2m_skill table. Once the migration for a particular table is done, its respective system property will be set to false. If you try to run the migration script for a particular table more than once, you will get the unique key violation error for records that already exist.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Migrate Skills to Task Skill M2M
